en.settings.officialBody: DeepSeek peak/valley pricing: weekdays 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time are peak hours, everything else is off-peak at exactly half the peak price, and weekends (Saturday & Sunday) are off-peak all day. On 2026-09-10 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash shipped with a price cut and the model was renamed to deepseek-flash — the legacy names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are still accepted but billed at the Flash price; V4 Pro retires at 12:00 Beijing time on 2026-09-14 and its requests are routed to (and billed as) V4.1-Flash. The official "peak / off-peak" is exactly this plugin's "busy / idle".

en.strategy.iterativeHint: Work that needs polishing — each round reviews and improves until stable. Good for analysis, writing, and code.
en.strategy.reviewHint: Important deliveries — after the run, an independent second look finds the flaws and leaves review notes.
en.strategy.samplingHint: Want a few options to choose from — several independent runs, you decide tomorrow. Good for titles, ideas, and candidate designs.
en.strategy.singleHint: Simple, clear jobs — one run is enough.
